cohort: 99 development patients, split 101; reserved patients not read

nnU-Net.nnU-Net + CTA: Sprint 12 A1_ct_maps_cta: fold-model probabilities, resampled linearly to the 2 mm grid; reported masks reloaded

primary.P1: nnU-Net + CTA, self-volume rule minus nnU-Net + CTA as reported (Dice): the total post-processing change (resampling + rule)
primary.P2: equal-weight average of tree and nnU-Net + CTA probabilities, self-volume rule, minus nnU-Net + CTA as reported (Dice): total change (combination + rule + resampling)

focused_exploratory: resampling only: same 50% rule, probabilities resampled to 2 mm before thresholding: nnU-Net + CTA, 50% rule after resampling minus nnU-Net + CTA, as reported
rule only: self-volume vs 50% rule on the same resampled probabilities: nnU-Net + CTA, self-volume rule minus nnU-Net + CTA, 50% rule after resampling
does combining add anything beyond the rule? both self-volume: average tree + nnU-Net, self-volume minus nnU-Net + CTA, self-volume rule
does tuned combining beat tuning nnU-Net's cut-off alone?: tuned combination (weight and cut-off) minus nnU-Net + CTA, tuned cut-off only
does tuned combining beat tuning the tree's cut-off alone?: tuned combination (weight and cut-off) minus tree, tuned cut-off only
oracle: per-patient best of the two reported masks, chosen with the true infarct: an oracle model-selection reference, not an upper bound on voxel-level fusion

bootstrap.intervals: percentile, patient resampling; primaries also Bonferroni 97.5%

tuning: leave-one-fold-out: weight and cut-off chosen on the other four folds' out-of-fold predictions. Those predictions come from fold models trained partly on the scored fold's patients, so the whole tuning procedure is not independent of the scored fold; its size is unknown. Tuned results are exploratory development estimates, not an unbiased held-out evaluation; confirmation needs a fully nested procedure or a frozen rule on untouched data.

grid.candidate support: tissue mask plus voxels with nnU-Net probability above 0.0001

metrics: patient-level values averaged over patients; Dice, precision, recall and lesion F1 computed exactly as in the saved tables (official lesion matching, IoU >= 0.2)
